pages.description: Reno Raines goes from detective to escaped fugitive to bounty hunter after a crooked fellow cop kills his wife and frames him for the murder.
pages.title: Renegade

episodes.description: Reno Raines , an undercover cop of the Las Vegas police force, finds himself the target of a deadly frame-up and on the run and out to clear his name.
episodes.title: S01:E01 - Pilot

episodes.description: Reno comes to the rescue of a car in trouble.
episodes.title: S01:E02 - Hunting Accident

episodes.description: A contract killer is hired to take out a small town judge.
episodes.title: S01:E03 - Final Judgment

episodes.description: News reports of Lt. Enrique Vilas' escape from El Salvador are accompanied by offers of a $100,000 reward for his capture.
episodes.title: S01:E04 - La Mala Sombra

episodes.description: After a dispute over a repair bill, a young motorcycle mechanic is murdered in cold blood by a maniacal cutthroat.
episodes.title: S01:E05 - Mother Courage

episodes.description: Reno's vacation in Las Vegas is derailed when Bobby enlists him to track down a bail jumper.
episodes.title: S01:E06 - Second Chance

episodes.description: For Reno Raines, taking refuge in a small-town saloon becomes hazerdous.
episodes.title: S01:E07 - Eye of the Storm

episodes.description: When Reno witnesses the cold-blooded murder of one of his trusted street pals, Reno himself becomes the victim of a brutal beating at the hands of the killers.
episodes.title: S01:E08 - Payback

episodes.description: In the moment before Reno apprehends a murderer,a helmeted motorcycle rider breaks up the party with a pistol.
episodes.title: S01:E09 - The Talisman

episodes.description: The pipe-bomb murder of Reno's ex-partner Jack Varnell sends Reno and Bobby south of the border in search of the cop-killer.
episodes.title: S01:E10 - Partners

episodes.description: Reno's latest job gets personal - the bounty is on the head of Earl Lyons, an ex-Army Ranger from Reno's unit.
episodes.title: S01:E11 - Lyon's Roar

episodes.description: Reno falls into a deadly trap when false news reports claim that Valerie Prentice, his comatose fiancee, has awakened.
episodes.title: S01:E12 - Val's Song

episodes.description: Reno assists a stranded motorist change her flat tire who later turns up dead.
episodes.title: S01:E13 - Give and Take

episodes.description: Reno's latest bounty kidnaps a wealthy Japanese businessman's daughter.
episodes.title: S01:E14 - Samurai

episodes.description: Appearances are deceiving, when Reno discovers a look alike is committing crimes in his name.
episodes.title: S01:E15 - The Two Renos

episodes.description: Reno rolls into town, tracking a gang of vicious cutthroats.
episodes.title: S01:E16 - Billy

episodes.description: A desperate psychotic escapes from a prison with a plan for revenge against the men who put him behind bars: Reno and Bobby.
episodes.title: S01:E17 - Headcase

episodes.description: The five-year old disappearance of B-movie starlet sends Reno south of the border, following a hot tip from one of Bobby's informants.
episodes.title: S01:E18 - The Hot Tip

episodes.description: When crooked Circuit Prosecutor Eli Starke hires some local thugs to thwart the efforts of a group of ex-convicts trying to go straight, Reno comes to their rescue.
episodes.title: S01:E19 - Moody River

episodes.description: Reno's old friend, D.A. Harry Wells, recruits him to help find his daughter Dawn, who is being held hostage by her drug-dealing boyfriend.
episodes.title: S01:E20 - Vanished
